# Elder Care Pakistan

> Elder Care Pakistan supports older people and their families through care coordination, mobility assistance, community programmes and responsible giving.

Official website: https://eldercarepakistan.org/

## Care and service enquiries

- [Get elder care support](https://eldercarepakistan.org/care-support.html): Programme links and how to ask about eligibility and availability.
- [Home nursing](https://eldercarepakistan.org/Nurse-at-Home.html): Ask about qualified nursing support where available.
- [Dialysis referrals](https://eldercarepakistan.org/Dialysis-at-Home.html): Renal-care guidance and qualified referrals.
- [Home physiotherapy](https://eldercarepakistan.org/Physiotherapy-at-Home.html): Guidance on physiotherapy support after review.
- [Contact and addresses](https://eldercarepakistan.org/Contact-Us.html): Confirm availability with the organisation. The contact page lists a Lahore head office and a Pattika, Muzaffarabad AJK care home address.

## About and giving

- [About](https://eldercarepakistan.org/About-Us.html): Organisation mission and leadership.
- [Elder care blogs](https://eldercarepakistan.org/blogs.html): Eight family guides linking to original articles on Tralionex Insights.
- [Ways to give](https://eldercarepakistan.org/master-donation-hub.html): Donation options and gifts in kind.
- [Donation and overseas transfer guidance](https://eldercarepakistan.org/Donate-Now1.html): Ask the organisation for verified instructions and receipt guidance.
